sentences.text: The documents do not state one single collateral for the MSE business term loan; one sanction letter states "Hypothecation of the machinery purchased out of the loan, and personal guarantee of Mrs." and another states "Registered mortgage of the commercial unit purchased out of the loan."
The sanction letter that mentions the commercial unit says the collateral is a "Registered mortgage" over the "commercial unit purchased out of the loan."
The sanction letter that mentions machinery says the collateral is "Hypothecation of the machinery purchased out of the loan" and "personal guarantee of Mrs."
